summary: Frontend-only test of the Excel/PDF export feature on /consulta (public) and the admin panel, plus the delete regression. Every requested flow passed. I downloaded each file and parsed its contents (openpyxl/pypdf). Files have the title, the period/filter label, the 8-column header (Data, Horário, Transportadora, Fornecedor, Nota fiscal, Volumes, Doca, Status), exactly the rows shown in the table, and a TOTAL row equal to 'Volumes previstos' (56 for 3 rows, 5 with the carrier filter, 10 for admin). Filenames: docksync-agenda-<start>.xlsx/.pdf, and docksync-agenda-<start>_<end>.* for 'Próximos 7 dias'. Export uses the applied filters, not text typed but not yet applied. Both buttons are disabled when empty-state shows. Admin sees and uses both buttons. Deleting while the carrier filter is applied reloads with the filter kept.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Hoje' filter sends only start=today. The backend applies $gte only, so 'Hoje' also lists future appointments (a 22/10 row appears on 21/10). The exported file is labeled '21/10/2026' but contains 22/10 rows, so the label is misleading.

integration_issues.issue: remove() and save() call load(filters), which is the input state, not 'applied'. If the user typed a filter without clicking Aplicar, that unapplied filter is silently applied after a delete or save. Suggest using load(applied).

action_items: Make 'Hoje' a single-day filter (set end=today in the filter-today handler), or make periodLabel show 'a partir de dd/mm' when only start is set
Use load(applied) instead of load(filters) in remove() and save()
Fix singular/plural in the export total ('1 agendamento')
Optional: remove leftover 'TEST UI Carrier' (UI-NF-1) appointment from iteration 1 still in DB
critical_code_review_comments: `today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)` is UTC. For BRT users after 21:00 local, 'Hoje' and the filename date will be tomorrow. Build the date from local date parts instead.
The 'Próximos 7 dias' end date also uses toISOString (UTC), with the same caveat
load() has no try/catch, so API failures leave the table stale with no error message
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_EXP appointments via admin UI; both deleted during test. Pre-existing 'TEST UI Carrier' record (from iteration 1) left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Downloads are saved with page.expect_download to /tmp/exports, then parsed with python /app/tests/check_exports.py (needs pip openpyxl pypdf). Credentials are in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Accept the delete confirm with a dialog handler.
rca of the issue: 'Hoje' includes future days: App.js filter-today handler sets {start: today, end: ''}. server.py list_appointments then builds only {$gte: start}, so all future dates are returned. periodLabel(f) shows just br(f.start), so the export label claims a single day.
